message.content:
The pain started in the middle of my upper back, between my shoulder blades, about two days ago. It stayed in one spot and didn't spread. After that my legs got weaker, and it kept getting worse until I couldn't stand up. I also lost control of my bladder and bowels. I can't say exactly how many hours the weakness took to get this bad.

I haven't had a fall or any injury. I haven't lifted anything heavy, and I haven't had a recent vaccine. I don't remember any spinal procedure or epidural, but I'm not sure that was covered. I haven't had a fever. I don't have any long-term illnesses, and I'm not on blood thinners or any other regular medicines. Cancer and injected drugs didn't come up in what I was able to tell you, so I don't have anything to add on those.
